# Generated files, one glob per line.
#
# Copy this file to .claude/generated-files.txt in your repository and edit it.
# The plugin's PreToolUse guard reads it and blocks any edit to a matching
# path, so a generated artifact can only change by being regenerated.
#
# Format: <glob> <command that regenerates it>
# Everything up to the first space is the glob. The rest of the line is shown
# to the agent when the edit is blocked, so say exactly what to run.
# A glob that does not start with / or * matches any path ending that way,
# which means repository-relative entries work whatever the checkout is named.
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

docs/contracts/openapi.json  npm run generate:api
src/clients/api/generated/*  npm run generate:api
src/clients/ws/generated.ts  scripts/generate-ws-types.sh
docs/architecture/INVENTORY.md  scripts/inventory/generate.py
